COOL_ROOF_ALBEDO.name: High-Albedo Cool Roof Coating & Reflective Membrane
COOL_ROOF_ALBEDO.description: Applies high-reflectance titanium dioxide elastomeric or thermoplastic white roof coatings (SRI > 80) to reflect shortwave solar radiation before absorption.

URBAN_FORESTRY_CANOPY.name: Intensive Urban Tree Canopy & Street Afforestation
URBAN_FORESTRY_CANOPY.description: Deploys multi-tier native shade trees (Neem, Honge, Peepal) to shade asphalt surfaces and maximize cooling via latent heat evapotranspiration.

GREEN_ROOFS_VERTICAL_GARDEN.name: Extensive Green Roofs & Bio-Solar Living Walls
GREEN_ROOFS_VERTICAL_GARDEN.description: Integrates lightweight modular sedum and succulent vegetative layers on roofs and vertical living facades to insulate buildings and reduce sensible heat flux.

PERMEABLE_COOL_PAVEMENTS.name: Permeable Interlocking Cool Pavements & Porous Asphalt
PERMEABLE_COOL_PAVEMENTS.description: Replaces standard impervious blacktop asphalt with high-albedo porous concrete or interlocking pavers that retain subsurface moisture and allow evaporative cooling.

EVAPORATIVE_MISTING_WATER_PLAZA.name: Micro-Misting Canopies & Urban Water Retention Plazas
EVAPORATIVE_MISTING_WATER_PLAZA.description: Installs high-pressure micro-nozzle misting lines and daylighted bioswales/shallow fountains to rapidly lower localized ambient air temperatures by 2-3°C through sensible heat absorption.
